item.title: State audit praises Livingston County, but urges tighter controls
item.description: An audit issued by Missouri State Auditor Scott Fitzpatrick concludes that Livingston County government is generally well run, assigning the county a “good” rating while identifying limited areas that warrant stronger oversight.
